title: Degree-one uniqueness for maps to conormal spectra
statement: Let $s:S\hookrightarrow V$ be a closed immersion [def-pur-normal-bundle], let $p:Y\to S$ be affine, and let $e:\operatorname{gr}_{\mathcal I}(\mathcal O_V)\simeq p_*\mathcal O_Y$ be an $\mathcal O_S$-algebra isomorphism [lem-pur-conormal-graded-algebra, lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-relative-spec]. For any scheme $T$ and $t:T\to S$, let $f,g:T\to Y$ satisfy $p\circ f=t=p\circ g$. If on every affine open $U\subseteq V$ their pullbacks agree on $e$ applied to each degree-one ideal section class over $s^{-1}(U)$, then $f=g$.

source.place: Local construction, x_i=t u_i, and the general associated-graded representative calculation, Stacks 0630, 0632 and 01LX.

proof.text: Compose e with the two sheaf pullbacks to t_*O_T. Apply degree-one conormal algebra uniqueness to identify the algebra maps. Over each affine open of S, Y is affine and Gamma-Spec identifies maps with section ring homomorphisms. The inverse images cover T; scheme hom-ext glues the equalities.

theorem conormalCone_hom_ext {V S T Y : Scheme.{u}} (s : S ⟶ V) [IsClosedImmersion s]
    (p : Y ⟶ S) [IsAffineHom p]
    (e : (ConormalGradedAlgebra.presentation s).algebra ≅
      Under.mk (⟨p.c⟩ : S.sheaf ⟶
        (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward CommRingCat.{u} p.base).obj Y.sheaf))
    (t : T ⟶ S) (f g : T ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ p = t) (hg : g ≫ p = t)
    (h : ∀ (U : V.affineOpens)
      (b : (ConormalGradedAlgebra.power s 1).val.obj (Opposite.op U.1)),
      (f.appLE (p ⁻¹ᵁ (s ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)) (t ⁻¹ᵁ (s ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))
        (by rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage f p, hf]))
          (e.hom.right.hom.app (Opposite.op (s ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))
            (ConormalGradedAlgebra.homogeneousClass s
              (ConormalGradedAlgebra.presentation s).algebra
              (ConormalGradedAlgebra.presentation s).inclusion 1 U.1 b)) =
      (g.appLE (p ⁻¹ᵁ (s ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)) (t ⁻¹ᵁ (s ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))
        (by rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage g p, hg]))
          (e.hom.right.hom.app (Opposite.op (s ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))
            (ConormalGradedAlgebra.homogeneousClass s
              (ConormalGradedAlgebra.presentation s).algebra
              (ConormalGradedAlgebra.presentation s).inclusion 1 U.1 b))) :
    f = g
